name: BodyTalk_7
short_caption: The robot remains virtually static with extremely minor, almost imperceptible micro-adjustments of its joints.
movement_description: The robot starts in a standard neutral resting posture facing forward. Throughout the short clip, there is no active gesture or significant movement; only tiny, natural-looking motor micro-drifts or idling adjustments occur in the arms and head. The sequence concludes with the robot in the exact same neutral resting pose.
